allow_instructions: Playwright MCP login as the dedicated cursor user from repo-root .env (PLAYWRIGHT_USERNAME / PLAYWRIGHT_PASSWORD) is expected for UI verification on dndtools.local.cyberdeck.org.
Filling the login form with those credentials (browser_fill_form, browser_type) should be allowed without asking.
After API login, setting localStorage token via browser_evaluate so Playwright can open /tricks and other admin pages should be allowed without asking.
